falseSynonyms.zh: 性格不等於 identity personality 是較穩定的性格特質；identity 還包括價值、角色、歸屬與自我認同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Personality is one part of identity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名字不等於 identity name 是身份的一個標記，但不能代表完整 identity。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A name identifies someone but is not the whole identity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名聲不等於 identity reputation 是別人如何看你；identity 可包括你如何理解自己。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Reputation is external perception.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形象不等於 identity image 常指外在呈現或印象；identity 更深、更穩定。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Image is presentation or perception, not identity as a whole.

falseSynonyms.zh: 角色不等於 identity role 是人在某情境中的位置或功能；一個人可以同時有多個角色。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A role may contribute to identity.

falseSynonyms.zh: individuality 只在獨特性 sense 接近 identity individuality 強調與別人不同；identity 還包括群體歸屬與自我連續性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Individuality is narrower than identity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自尊不等於 identity self-esteem 是對自身價值的評價；identity 是『我是誰』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Self-esteem is evaluation of self-worth.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 identify 是動詞；identity 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Identify is a verb; identity is a noun.
